title: Magma... Magma Cream Blocks
description: Turns Magma Blocks into Magma Cream Blocks... Who would ask for this?
body:
**Ever wondered what Magma Blocks would look like if they were made of Magma Cream? No?**

## Now you don't have to!

![Magma Cream Blocks in the Nether](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/863129593f5d39b1f62fef835751f2e7319824f2.png)

This resource pack renames and retextures Magma Blocks into Magma Cream Blocks, making them more consistent with the item.

![It burns!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c10d830cb79a88ab753ba019066a5c4e7a2b95a8.png)

 _join my discord to report bugs!_
